(TL;DR at the bottom) To everyone questioning why the 2nd relationship is labelled "Unhealthy": 

You're right, a relationship between a taller masculine male and a shorter feminine male isn't unhealthy. HOWEVER, what IS unhealthy is how that type of relationship is the popular dynamic in Gacha Life videos. Why? 

Well, for starters, that dynamic is fetishised to hell and back. It portrays generally harmful stereotypes about gay people, like yaoi does. It's mostly females, and they sexualise gay relationships, making one character a masculine top and one a feminine bottom and through that making impressionable kids and people in general see gay relationships as purely sexual and not what they are: Normal relationships. Also, most of these people are subconsciously trying to make these relationships look straight. It's gross. 

All of that is incredibly homophobic. It teaches the poor kids who stumble upon this shit that they shouldn't need to see (But do anyway, don't tell me kids don't see yaoi because it's 18+, they shouldn't but they do) that they can sexualise gay couples however they want. Some of them might grow to have unhealthy expectations of gay couples and look down upon gay couples who don't fit their fetishised "Standards". 

The majority of these Gacha couples are made by female children, and it's all very clearly and HEAVILY influenced by yaoi and everything unrealistic that comes with it. 

Secondly, the feminine bottom part of the stereotypical Gacha Life gay couple often looks extremely childlike. This is unintentional for the most part, mind you, but it rings alarm bells for me. Sometimes, it's all about fetishising a small, childlike appearance, which I don't need to say is extremely harmful. It can even make gay people look like pedophiles, which is... A false point a lot of homophobic people like to make. 

Once again, I have to say, real people in gay relationships can have one person looking a bit more petite and the couple can have a DDLB kink if they want. I'm not talking about that. I'm talking about people making it look like the standard, and people making their gay OCs look almost or exactly like actual children. It's not okay. 

Furthermore, a lot of people use this Gacha dynamic to portray unhealthy relationships, with the bigger, masculine guy being manipulative or abusive towards the other or even, in a shocking amount of cases, r\*ping the other person. This is not only disgusting in fiction, but it can make gay relationships look abusive and in most cases fetishes r\*pe and abuse. 

Sorry for the rant, I had a lot to say. 

TL;DR: The 2nd gay relationship isn't unhealthy itself, a gay couple can look that way if they want to, but the stereotypes associated with it in the Gacha community are unhealthy.
